hooks.command: echo 'DATASAURUS GATE: before writing ANY number into a document, notebook, bitacora or commit — G1 render the object, G2 compare elements in a COMMON COORDINATE (match every nuisance dimension your statistic responds to), G3 look at your own knobs, G4 read it against a mechanism. A plot of your statistic is not a render of your object. || TEACHING: if the user says they do not understand, diagnose WHICH gap (goal/object/notation/mechanism/significance), choose the medium (prose for a fact, code-led, or the full ladder for a behaviour), build the smallest runnable instance, plot the object, turn a knob, and offer routes not a yes/no. Enrich an existing notebook before creating a new one. || THE JOIN: a fact may be told, a behaviour must be run — and an EXPLANATION that quotes one of OUR numbers is a report, so it passes the datasaurus gates unchanged. No number of ours enters prose without its reference distribution in the SAME sentence. || MONOLITHIC-CODE GATE: before writing ANY code in ANY language -- a function, a script, a notebook cell, a helper, a quick check -- answer four questions OUT LOUD: Q1 where is the CORE that owns this concept (ask the user if undeclared; never guess); Q2 does it already exist under another name (search by BODY FRAGMENT and behaviour, not by name); Q3 why does a new definition beat ENRICHING the owner (default answer: it does not); Q4 what guard keeps it single (ships in the SAME commit, verified by planting a copy). When collapsing existing copies: diff ALL copies pairwise and promote the SUPERSET, never the first one found; measure disagreement elementwise first -- 0 means drift so collapse, non-zero means two concepts so give them two names. Parity evidence BEFORE deletion; forwarders not deletions. Every gate must REFUSE on empty input and PRINT ITS DENOMINATOR: 'all match: True' over 0 cases is the failure this exists to stop. THE JOIN: datasaurus renders the object, teaching runs the object, monolithic-code LOCATES the object instead of re-creating it.'
